decompose_matrix: decompose a 4x4 transformation matrix into scale, shear, euler angles, translation, and perspective components
compose_matrix: compose a 4x4 transformation matrix from scale, shear, euler angles, translation, and perspective parameters
quaternion_slerp: spherically interpolate between two quaternions by a given fraction for smooth rotation animation
affine_matrix_from_points: compute an affine transformation matrix to register and align two 3D point sets
rotation_matrix: create a 4x4 rotation matrix from an angle, direction axis, and optional pivot point
